verdict.rationale: mParticle is a SaaS CDP whose docs list programmatic HTTP and platform APIs: direct event sending, the Warehouse Sync API, the Audiences platform API and a real-time API. Together these imply it can be scripted and automated without the UI. However, the evidence is mostly bare doc titles, and nothing shows a CLI, CI integration, or headless automation workflow. Some setup flows, such as connecting audiences via Data Platform > Setup > Directory, are described as UI clicks. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless tooling, CI/CD pipeline documentation, API-driven configuration of setup and connections, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of automation use.
